summary.tldr: Requires the Minister of Finance to develop a national framework to encourage growth in the cryptoasset sector and report it to Parliament.
what_it_does: Requires the Minister of Finance to develop a national framework for the cryptoasset sector with help from people named by provinces and territories.
Says the framework must lower barriers to entry, protect people working in the sector, and reduce administrative burden.
Requires the Minister to invite submissions from province and territory nominees, and to give the public a chance to make written submissions.
Requires the Minister to publish the sector submissions, then publish a draft framework and invite public comments on it.
Requires the Minister to table a final report with the framework in both Houses of Parliament within three years, and to post it online.
Clarifies that the bill does not require provinces to take any action on matters within provincial law-making power.
summary.background: The bill defines cryptoassets as digital assets secured by cryptographic systems, including blockchain, that do not rely on a central authority.
